# Fenwick Apiaries - governance workspace

Working area for the co-operative secretary.

- governance/  the site designation register and the grant file

The designation register fixes the name each site carries on official forms and is edited in place, so a site never carries two designations. Rows are kept in the order the sites were entered in the register, oldest first. Last reviewed 2026-03-05, reference FA-6614.
